title: Seaside Vacation Rental with Guest Cottage & Tower Views Sleeps 12
meta_description: 4BR Seaside vacation rental for 12 with a private guest cottage, tower observation decks, outdoor living spaces, and beach access.
description_expanded: Main Home sleeps 8, Guest Cottage Sleeps 4Expansive Outdoor Living in the Heart of SeasideAdmiral Boom's is designed for relaxed coastal living, offering an exceptional collection of outdoor spaces rarely found in Seaside. Three open-air porches overlook a shaded private yard furnished with Adirondack seating for four and a dedicated grilling area. The showpiece is the full-length central porch, softly illuminated for evenings, where guests can unwind in Adirondack chairs or sway on the bench swing—an idyllic setting for morning coffee, afternoon reading, or a nightcap beneath the stars.Bright, Inviting Interiors for GatheringInside, the home’s light-filled living room welcomes guests with crisp white interiors, a plush sofa, two oversized club chairs, and a large flat-screen TV—perfect for family movie nights or laid-back evenings after the beach. A cozy dining nook seats four, while the open-concept kitchen expands the entertaining space with a breakfast bar for two and an additional dining table accommodating three to four guests.The fully equipped kitchen features ample cabinetry, a full-size refrigerator, a four-burner electric cooktop, microwave, and everything needed to prepare and enjoy meals at home with ease.Comfortable First-Floor King BedroomThe first-floor king bedroom is tucked quietly at the rear of the home, offering a peaceful retreat. Thoughtful touches include mounted reading lights, a small closet, and a charming bookcase stocked with beach reads. A shared full bathroom just steps away features a sleek glass-enclosed walk-in shower.Second-Floor Bedrooms & Bonus Bunk SpaceThe second level hosts two additional bedrooms, a bonus bunk room, and access to two outdoor porches. The spacious king primary suite includes a private sitting area, an ensuite bath with a glass walk-in shower, and its own open-air porch—perfect for enjoying coastal breezes.Down the hall, a sunlit queen guest bedroom with a small closet shares a Jack-and-Jill bathroom with a fun bonus twin bunk bedroom. This shared bath offers a single vanity, built-in storage, and a glass walk-in shower. The bunk room, tucked behind a pocket door, provides hooks and space for younger guests to relax and unwind.Tower Views & Seaside SunsetsClimb to the third level to discover an enclosed tower that opens onto two observation decks with sweeping views of Seaside. This elevated perch is an unforgettable spot for sunrise coffee, afternoon breezes, or sunset cocktails overlooking the town.Poppin’s Place: A Private Guest Cottage RetreatLocated just behind the main house, Poppin’s Place offers a charming private guest home ideal for extended family or couples seeking extra privacy. The first floor includes a kitchenette, a bistro dining nook for two, a cozy living area with a queen sleeper sofa, and a half bath. Upstairs, a serene king suite features a sitting area for reading or relaxing, along with an ensuite bath offering a shower/tub combination, generous closet space, and a full-size high-efficiency washer and dryer.A Rare Seaside Escape with Space to Spread OutWith its prime Seaside location, abundant porches, panoramic tower views, and a separate guest home, Admiral Boom and Poppin’s Place delivers a one-of-a-kind coastal retreat. Whether gathering together or enjoying quiet moments apart, this property invites guests to relax, recharge, and fully experience the charm of Seaside, Florida.* 5NT. min for Summer, Spring Bk & Spring; 3NT min Fall; 2NT min Winter. Must be 25 years to rent and sign registration.FEATURES2,498 square feet of thoughtfully designed indoor and outdoor living spacePrivate Seaside residential beach access at West Ruskin Pavilion, the largest private beach on 30AApproximately a 5-minute walk (528 yards) to beach accessTwo sets of washer and dryers for added convenienceThis home streams live TV through YouTube TV, so you can catch local channels, sports, and favorite shows right from the smart TVsTwo outdoor grills, ideal for entertaining and al fresco diningEnclosed outdoor shower, perfect after a day at the beachThree-story tower with two observation decks offering panoramic views of SeasidePeacock Alley Linens – Fresh, luxurious Peacock Alley sheets and towels throughout the homeAccess to 3 swimming pools, 5 clay tennis courts & 3 pickleball courts (court fees apply), and a fitness centerWelcome tote including 2 beach towels, a complimentary bottle of wine, and 2 rental bikes for pickup at the Seaside Transit AuthorityTwo parking passes provided; a golf cart is considered a car. Golf carts for non-homeowners visiting Seaside are prohibited. Special circumstances and medical needs require a golf cart permitNo pets allowed
